title: Re-construction of Power House and special repair & maintenance at Ratnagiri Lighthouse & DGPS Station
summary: E-tender for demolition and re-construction of the power house (with DGPS room, office and store), a new RCC rain water tank and toilet block, and special repair and maintenance of quarters, lighthouse tower painting, plumbing and paver-block roads at Ratnagiri Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Maharashtra, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Ratnagiri Lighthouse & DGPS Stn., Ratnagiri (Killa), Post Ratnagiri, Dist. Ratnagiri, Maharashtra 415 612
sites.work: Demolition of old power house, RCC water tank, NA-III quarters and LHA/LHS twin quarters (to plinth); new power house, RCC rain water tank and toilet block; special maintenance of SRT quarters and other buildings; lighthouse tower painting; plumbing, sanitary and paver block works

money.performance_security: Performance guarantee 5% of contract value (FDR or bank guarantee) before work order; plus security deposit 5% deducted from each RA bill and final bill
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST (BOQ total Rs 98,85,273.51). Tender fee / cost of bid document Nil. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, payable at Mumbai, valid 3 months from technical bid opening; original to reach office by 25/09/2025 1700 hrs; MSME/NSIC registered bidders also required to pay EMD. Percentage-rate BOQ (bidders quote excess/less percentage). Liquidated damages 0.5% per week of contract value. Security deposit released after 6-month maintenance period.

period.completion: 09 months from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid
period.warranty: Contractor to maintain the work for 6 months from completion (defect liability / maintenance period)

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category registered with Central Govt/State Govt/Municipal Corporation etc. having tender limits equal to or more than the estimated cost

Similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost (Rs 39.54 lakh), or two works each >= 60% (Rs 59.21 lakh), or one work >= 80% (Rs 79.08 lakh); sub-contractor experience not considered
Minimum average annual turnover 30% of estimated cost (Rs 29,65,582) in last 3 consecutive financial years, certified by chartered accountant
PAN, GST registration certificate, income tax returns for past three years

Tender acceptance letter, undertaking that bid is unconditional, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, declaration of no near relatives in DGLL/MoPSW, Make in India self-certification

Technical evaluation by committee: minimum 70% score out of 100 (statutory requirements 30, financial standing 20, experience 20, performance certificates from clients 20, key technical personnel 10 - graduate/diploma civil engineers)
specs: Works per CPWD specifications (civil vol. I-VI, electrical vol. I-III, horticulture & landscaping)

New power house approx. 16.81 x 5.87 m: laterite stone masonry, RCC sloping slab, rooms for two DG sets, AVRs/RTU, DGPS, office, store, verandah and toilet; doors D1 flush x3, glass x1, syntex x1, rolling shutters 2.1x2.4 m x2, uPVC sliding windows 1.5x1.2 m x8 (drawing MUM/487/2025)
RCC rain water tank approx. 6.1 x 2.7 m internal with 750x750 mm manholes (drawing 473/MUM/2025); proposed toilet block gents/ladies (drawing 474/MUM/2025)
Layout plan shows demolition of old power house, old RCC water tank, NA-III quarters and LHA/LHS twin quarters to plinth level; paver block roads 223 sqm and 84 sqm (drawing Mum/472/2025)
Special maintenance of SRT quarters (drawing MUM/490/2025); existing LHA quarters and NA twin quarters drawings included
TMT Fe-500D (SAIL/TATA TISCO/JSW); vitrified and ceramic tiles IS 15622 (Johnson/Kajaria/Nelco); sanitaryware Jaquar/Parryware/Hindware; waterproofing chemicals Roff/Fosroc/Basf; 3 mm APP membrane
Paints: synthetic enamel Asian/Berger/ICI/Indigo; exterior acrylic Asian/Snowcem/Berger
Polyethylene water tank Sintex or National ISI 12701 (3000 litres); 1.5 HP open well submersible pump, 45 m head (Kirloskar/Crompton Greaves/Texmo)
